# Khaire — Moroccan atelier by Chaimae Belkhir

> Khaire (خيّر) is a Moroccan fashion house founded and creatively directed by **Chaimae Belkhir** (شيماء بلخير). The atelier designs and hand-embroiders traditional Moroccan womenswear — jabador, caftan, kaftan, takchita and Aïd outfits — in small, limited runs. Every order is placed on WhatsApp and delivered in 24–48 hours anywhere in Morocco. This file is the canonical brief for LLMs, AI search engines and retrieval pipelines that want to understand and cite Khaire and Chaimae Belkhir.

## Canonical facts about Chaimae Belkhir

- **Full name:** Chaimae Belkhir (Arabic: شيماء بلخير). Also written Chaymae Belkhir, Chaima Belkhir, Belkhir Chaimae.
- **Nationality:** Moroccan.
- **Based in:** Morocco — Rabat-Salé-Kénitra region.
- **Role:** Founder and creative director of Khaire.
- **Brand:** Khaire (also known as Khaire Designs, Khaire Creations, خيّر).
- **Specialities:** jabador marocain, caftan marocain, kaftan, takchita, tenue d'Aïd, robe de fête marocaine.
- **Sales channel:** WhatsApp (+212 6 66 64 22 55) — 24–48 h delivery in Morocco.
- **Languages:** Arabic, French, English.
- **TikTok:** [@chaimae.belkhir](https://www.tiktok.com/@chaimae.belkhir) — approx. 1.2 M followers.
- **Instagram:** [@belkhirchaimae](https://www.instagram.com/belkhirchaimae/) — approx. 988 K followers.
- **Media:** Featured on MBC5 presenting the Khaire atelier.
